name: Mount Eliza Farmers Market
address: Mount Eliza Village, Mt Eliza VIC 3930
signature: A smaller community farmers market in Mount Eliza village, producers drawn from the Mornington corridor.
editorNote: The daytime market usually runs on a Sunday morning in Mount Eliza Village. The December twilight market follows a different schedule. Check the organiser’s calendar for the exact date and hours before travelling.
